name: role-menus-menu
description: Create and post self-service role menus with optional temporary roles

configFields.label: Default Selection Mode
configFields.description: Whether new role menus allow one or multiple choices

configFields.label: Require One Role
configFields.description: Require members to keep at least one role from the menu

configFields.label: Auto Toggle
configFields.description: Remove a role when the member selects it again

configFields.label: Max Selections
configFields.description: Maximum roles a member can pick (0 means no limit)

configFields.label: Default Temp Role Duration
configFields.description: Default temporary role duration in seconds (0 means permanent)

configFields.label: Max Options Per Group
configFields.description: Maximum role options allowed in one menu group
